description: This PHP source file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'CompanyStructureDao' that manages 'Subunit' entities within an organizational structure. It provides methods for retrieving, saving, adding, deleting subunits, updating organization names, and fetching subunit trees and maximum levels.

classes.name: CompanyStructureDao
classes.description: A DAO class for managing Subunit entities within the organization hierarchy.

methods.name: getSubunitById
methods.description: Retrieves a Subunit entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveSubunit
methods.description: Persists a Subunit entity to the database.

methods.name: addSubunit
methods.description: Adds a Subunit as a child to a parent subunit in the organizational hierarchy.

methods.name: setOrganizationName
methods.description: Updates the name of the organization at level 0.

methods.name: getSubunitTree
methods.description: Fetches the hierarchical tree of subunits up to a specified depth.

methods.name: getMaxLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum level value among all subunits.
